patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I threw my back out carrying my team to Diamond—okay, actually lifting a couch after ranked. It hurts to bend, but my legs feel normal: no numbness, and everything works down there.
presentation.triageNote: 35-year-old male with lower back pain beginning while lifting a couch. Pain is worse with bending and there is paraspinal tenderness; leg strength and sensation are normal, with no groin numbness or bladder symptoms.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because a stable mechanical back strain without neurologic, infectious, or bladder red flags is not expected to require a counted emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient developed localized lower-back pain while lifting, with movement-related pain and paraspinal tenderness but normal leg strength and sensation.
clinical.acuityReason: The mechanism and examination support conservative treatment; there is no indication for urgent imaging or invasive testing.
keyFindings: Pain began while lifting a couch
teachingPoints: Routine imaging does not improve care for uncomplicated acute mechanical back pain without red flags.
Return precautions should emphasize new weakness, saddle numbness, bladder or bowel dysfunction, fever, or escalating pain.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Conservative treatment with oral analgesia, activity guidance, and return precautions would usually allow discharge without testing.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: standing, one hand on his lower back, mild grimace
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 35-year-old man in a casual gamer t-shirt, beside a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: standing, one hand pressed to his lower back, leaning slightly. Expression: annoyed with a mild wince. Clearly visible: a hand on the lower back; he otherwise looks well and healthy. No text, no logos.
